profile.description.en: Here are your account details based on your registered profile information.
profile.description.id: Berikut adalah rincian akun Anda berdasarkan informasi profil yang terdaftar.

profile.password.description.en: Verify your current password before saving a new one.
profile.password.description.id: Verifikasi password saat ini sebelum menyimpan password baru.

profile.password.helper.en: Use at least 6 characters and do not reuse your current password.
profile.password.helper.id: Gunakan minimal 6 karakter dan jangan pakai ulang password saat ini.

profile.password.errors.minLength.en: New password must be at least 6 characters.

profile.password.errors.sameAsCurrent.en: New password must be different from the current password.
profile.password.errors.sameAsCurrent.id: Password baru harus berbeda dari password saat ini.

profile.password.errors.mismatch.en: Password confirmation does not match the new password.
profile.password.errors.mismatch.id: Konfirmasi password tidak sama dengan password baru.
